provenance.what: Fourth live run: the full golden set with everything phase 1 built enabled - hybrid retrieval, streaming resolution, follow-up rewriting, keep-warm, and the semantic cache with its three arbiters.
provenance.models: Chat: Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 Q4_K_M via llama-cpp-python, 8,192-token window. Embeddings: nomic-embed-text v1.5 Q4_K_M, task prefixes applied.
provenance.corpus: evals/corpus/aveline minus archive/ - 10 documents across Markdown, Word, Excel and PDF
provenance.golden_set: evals/golden-aveline - 26 cases, 17 answerable, 9 must-refuse, 37 wrong-answer guards
provenance.compared_against: third-live-run-hybrid.json via eval --baseline; every metric matched
provenance.what_it_caught_first: The first run of this gate scored 94.1%: the semantic cache served the cached employee-entitlement answer ('20 weeks') to the contractor question, because the coverage arbiter searched the cached ANSWER for the question's content words and the live model's answer had volunteered a sentence about contractors. Coverage now runs against the cached question alone - an entry vouches for its question, never for its answer's ramblings. This run is the same set after that fix.
provenance.speed_context: Separately measured on the same stack: first status event 0.2s and progressive tokens over a real socket (previously 15-30s of silence); a covered paraphrase serves from the semantic tier in 1.4s where the model path took 27s; 'what about contractors?' resolves to a standalone question costing ~10 output tokens.
provenance.not_evidence_of: accuracy on real documents - the corpus and questions were written together. It shows the pipeline behaves identically with every phase-1 feature on.
provenance.reproduce: docs/TEST-RUN.md; enable OK_EMBEDDING_* and serve nomic-embed with --embedding true.
